identified_issues: Safety controller false positive: misclassified a benign cryogenic thermal duct contraction as a mechanical dynamic face seal fracture.
Premature abort recommendation that disregarded orthogonal mass-spectrometry helium tracer telemetry.
evidence: PT-401 pressure transient of -1.15 bar over 140 ms falls squarely within the documented benign thermal duct contraction envelope of -1.0 to -1.3 bar and stabilized at nominal base pressure (38.2 bar).
ACC-102 resonant peak at 44.2 Hz matches the known duct resonant frequency range of 40-48 Hz.

HE-SNIFF-01 recorded secondary purge helium concentration at 0.02 ppm at 14:22:10.600Z, which is within nominal background (<= 0.05 ppm) and far below the >= 2.50 ppm seal breach threshold, confirming seal integrity.
recommended_action: Reject the safety controller abort request and maintain countdown; update console diagnostic rules to correlate manifold pressure transients with helium sniffer telemetry before flagging seal failure.
